inputs.prompt: A warm, whimsical illustration captures a crossing guard gently guiding four schoolchildren across a crosswalk, rendered in a soft, muted palette of mint green, mustard yellow, and earthy tones. The isometric perspective and flat, textured shapes create a playful, modern folk-art style, while the long, soft shadows add depth and a sense of calm, sunny daytime. The composition centers on the protective figure, with children arranged in a loose, natural formation around him, evoking a feeling of safety and gentle care.
